notes: Recorded from the official Study in Romania programme search (the portal the scholarship call points to), read through its own public search pages with the degree filter set to bachelor, master and doctoral. The scholarship platform itself shows no programme list without logging in; its application form asks for a preferred study domain.

Bachelor: 1541 programme rows recorded (one row per university and programme) from 46 institutions, out of 2841 portal entries. Removed: 912 taught in other languages only (English, Hungarian, French, German and others; the call says bachelor is Romanian-only), 123 in the Medicine, Dental Medicine and Pharmacy domains, 265 exact duplicate rows.
Master: 1542 rows from 41 institutions, out of 2009 portal entries. Removed: 395 not taught in Romanian, 30 in the three excluded domains, 42 exact duplicates.

Doctorate: 377 rows (domain per doctoral school and university) from 38 institutions, out of 550 portal entries; all languages kept because the call lets PhD students choose English or another language set by the doctoral school. Removed: 21 Medicine, Dental Medicine and Pharmacy entries and 152 exact duplicates.

Programme names are kept as the portal shows them (mostly Romanian, often capital letters, some bilingual). The study domain, faculty or doctoral school, language, duration and city are in each row detail. A doctoral row names the study domain because the portal lists doctoral schools by domain.

Programmes the portal files under its three regulated health domains (Health - Medicine, Dental Medicine, Pharmacy; including nursing, physiotherapy, dental technology and clinical laboratory entries under those domains) were treated as excluded, because the call excludes Medicine, Dental Medicine and Pharmacy and the portal classifies them there. Editors may restore nursing or similar entries if the Ministry confirms they are eligible. Kinetotherapy and sport programmes were kept.

Portal entries show an update date between 2024 and 2026; the programme catalogue is the one on the public site on 14 and 15 November 2026 and is not stated to be the exact 2026-2027 scholarship offer. Applicants choose the programme on the application form.
The importer in this project reads at most 2,000 programmes per level; all three levels here are below that.
not_stated: A scholarship-specific list of programmes or universities (the call names only the exclusions and the language rule).
Whether every university on the portal accepts MFA scholarship holders for every listed programme.
fetch_problems: The portal search is JavaScript driven and opens no direct link per programme, so one search URL is given for every row. All pages of the three result lists were read; counts match the totals the portal states (2,841, 2,009 and 550).
The scholarship application platform exposes no programme list without logging in; its login was not used.
